structure.note: Ordinary (voting) and non-voting preferred shares. Of the votes on the 295,089,818 ordinary shares at December 31, 2024, Porsche Automobil Holding SE held 53.3%, the State of Lower Saxony 20.0% and Qatar Holding LLC 17.0%; 9.7% were free float. The annual report states that Hans Michel Piëch, Ferdinand Oliver Porsche and Wolfgang Porsche, 'together with other family shareholders, are indirectly controlling shareholders of Porsche Automobil Holding SE, which is the largest single shareholder of Volkswagen AG.' Under Article 11(1) of the Articles of Association, Lower Saxony may appoint two Supervisory Board members while it holds at least 15% of the ordinary shares.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, from Volkswagen's Annual Report 2024 and Consolidated Financial Statements 2024 PDFs on uploads.vw-mms.de, the document host linked from volkswagen-group.com/en/financial-reports. EUR, converted exactly from € millions. LEADER: Herbert Diess left the Board of Management on August 31, 2022 (his contract ran on to October 24, 2025). The FY2024 report gives no shareholding for him, so status is 'no-reported-stake'. HOLDERS: percentages are of subscribed capital (ordinary plus preferred), as the chart states, so they are economic. The Porsche and Piëch families' interest is held through Porsche SE (the report names Hans Michel Piëch, Ferdinand Oliver Porsche and Wolfgang Porsche among the family shareholders who indirectly control Porsche SE); it is not listed separately, to avoid double counting, and the report gives no family look-through percentage. Lower Saxony's 11.8% is held 'in part indirectly' (the annual report's related-party note says the State and Hannoversche Beteiligungsgesellschaft Niedersachsen mbH held 20.00% of the voting rights). The chart's other categories (foreign institutional investors 18.3%, private shareholders/others 25.7%, German institutional investors 1.9%) are groups, not holders, so they are not listed. DIVIDENDS: €4,524 million to Volkswagen AG shareholders (retained-earnings column of the statement of changes in equity); the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' of €5,779 million also includes €651 million to hybrid capital investors and €604 million to non-controlling interests, both excluded. BUYBACKS: 0; no purchases of own shares appear in the cash-flow statement or statement of changes in equity. STOCK COMP: null. Volkswagen's share-based payment (note 45) consists only of cash-settled performance share plans based on the preferred share price; no shares are granted. The note gives expenses by plan (€54 million for the Board of Management and top management, €576 million for members of management and selected participants, €115 million for other Group companies' plans, including Porsche AG and TRATON) but no total, so no figure is recorded rather than summing. GEOGRAPHY: five regions as reported; the 'Hedges sales revenue' column (€–219 million) is omitted, so segments sum to €324,875 million against the €324,656 million total.
